title: Asset Library prints "ERROR: ImageLoaderSVG: Failed to create SVG from buffer, error code 30." on asset with invalid PNG files
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.beta4 (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/93d270693079ea7802c9e1334a2e0ecd8529eeed)
- Reproducible in 4.3.stable
- Didn't test earlier versions but likely reproducible too, it's not a bug per se, just too verbose an error log.

### System information

Fedora Linux 41 (KDE Plasma) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7600M XT (RADV NAVI33) - AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

When browsing the asset library, some assets may have invalid files for icon or screenshots, which can trigger this error in the output dock:
```
ERROR: ImageLoaderSVG: Failed to create SVG from buffer, error code 30.
   at: load_mem_svg (modules/svg/image_loader_svg.cpp:75)
```

I see this on this asset specifically: https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/3043

Which seems to have invalid PNG files as icon and screenshots. It's a bit weird that the error bubbles up to the SVG loader when it's a file with PNG extension.

My expectation would be for the asset library not to show an explicit error to the end user, who can't do anything about it. This should be a verbose message maybe. But also the fact that it goes to test SVG might be a bug.

### Steps to reproduce

- Open Godot project
- Search for "PlayerConnect" https://godotengine.org/asset-library/asset/3043 in Asset Library
- Check output dialog
